title: Per-VC result written by a readiness runner (pack 06 harness for driver electron; same shape for the other drivers)

measured.description: the value the test measured (number, string, object); absent when the case only asserts

target.description: copied from expected_results.json (target or expected) for the reader's convenience

artefacts.description: paths relative to the repo root: traces, videos, screenshots, logs, crash folders

errorCode.description: E2E_* code (TECHNICAL_SPEC §8) or the pack's code observed

reason.description: why skipped / known / failed, one line
